items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 148:1
items.html: (To the question) This is the rule: everything that is in the lower one, he takes from the aspect corresponding to him in his upper one. Therefore, the Mochin of the externality, which are the Mochin of VAK, namely the internality of the externality, he takes from the NHY of the internality of the externality of Ima, namely from the aspect of the NHY of this Partzuf, for ZA. And the Mochin of the three aspects of the Aba and Ima of the internality, he receives from the three Partzufim of the Aba and Ima of the inner Ima, which clothe in the NHY of that Partzuf and afterwards clothe in the three Partzufim of the Aba and Ima of ZA. And this is what he says: “First the GAR of the externality of ZA return into the internality of the externality, namely the NHY of Ima; and afterwards the three aspects of the internality of ZA return within the three aspects of the internality of the NHY of Ima.” For this is the rule, that in the lights the lower ones are found coming first, and therefore first the Mochin of VAK return into the NHY of the internality of the externality of Ima; and afterwards come the Aba and Ima of the aspect of the GAR, called the Aba and Ima of face to face, which come in the three aspects of the Aba and Ima of the internality of Ima, clothed in the NHY of each one, as above. (Item 185).
